kjv: [There is] no speech nor language, [where] their voice is not heard (KJV 19:3)
mine: There is no speech, nor are there words; their voice is not heard
note: 'en-'omer we'en devarim beli nishma' qolam: the heavens' testimony is wordless, "without their voice being heard"; the KJV's italic "where" reverses it into a claim that their voice is heard in every language.
